facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.

Grimny's ghost says Bral, who lost the map to the party in a gambling bet, probably hid the treasure in the Dragon's Lair, a very small one-room cave the dwarves once scouted as a hiding place. Read Languages confirms that one map location is labelled "Dragon's lair".
Dr. Uriah's Read Languages spell reveals the writing under one treasure-map location per day.
What is the map's remaining unidentified marked location? Sir Phidipaldi guesses it is King Hogboon's, though Hogboon's goblin castle in the ruined temple lies near an unmarked area of the map.
The dragon said to live in the Dragon's Lair stands between the party and the treasure believed hidden there.
